summary: Kerala first-party eMaps/Bhu-Naksha and Ente Bhoomi sources establish a cadastral/land-record system, and the Directorate directory evidences Kasaragod district survey custodians. The legacy eMaps host redirected but failed TLS verification; the current Ente Bhoomi page was readable, its cadastral host returned 403, and staging timed out. No safe anonymous parcel geometry and stable native ID were obtained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Malayalam discovery queries are recorded in the city record. They identified Kerala eMaps/Bhu-Naksha, Ente Bhoomi, Kasaragod district survey offices, digital-survey camp offices, and district revenue references. No public anonymous parcel API response was identified.
requestOutcomes: The current Ente Bhoomi HTML and home JavaScript were fetched. Its CSP identifies current BhuNaksha hosts, but the cadastral host returned HTTP 403 and staging timed out. The legacy eMaps HTTP route redirected to HTTPS, whose expired certificate prevented safe retrieval. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS disablement was used.
